evidence: BeO was deposited using an Atomic Classic ALD instrument (Loadlock Module, CN1) with a reaction chamber temperature of 250 °C, precursor sublimation temperature of 110 °C, Be pulse of 3 s, H2O pulse of 1 s, Be purge of 20 s, H2O purge of 30 s, and chamber pressure of 0.8 Torr by performing 200 cycles at 0.8 Å/cycle.
